title: Add Valdy - AI-Powered Startup Validation to business
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Valdy - AI-Powered Startup Validation](https://samo-fex.github.io/valdy) to business
- Validate startup ideas with Valdy, an AI-powered validation tool that uses real-world data and AI analysis to support entrepreneurs and product managers.

Fixes #11156

gist.headline: Ideas meet the garden test
gist.blurb: Valdy joined the business garden to help founders give startup ideas a proper reality check. Polli brought the data, the questions, and a tiny clipboard.
gist.summary: Added Valdy to the business app catalog, giving entrepreneurs and product managers an AI-powered tool that combines real-world data with analysis to validate startup ideas.
gist.impact: People browsing Pollinations business apps can now find Valdy and use its data-informed AI analysis to assess ideas before planting too many weeks of work.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Valdy as a cozy startup-validation workbench: a retro dashboard shows a seedling idea being examined with friendly data charts, checkmarks, and a magnifying glass. Polli, wearing a tiny founder-style cap and holding a clipboard, helps inspect the seedling beside a pot of code-plants and small garden flowers; the scene makes validation feel like testing whether a seed has the conditions to grow.
